qpdf.purpose: Structural PDF validation (qpdf --check). Not a PDF/A or PDF/UA validator.
qpdf.availability: Installed on the Linux CI runner; optional elsewhere.

verapdf.purpose: Optional inspection of the ordinary quality baseline, without a profile claim. Dedicated conformance APIs require the separately pinned veraPDF 1.30.3 and validate final output.
verapdf.availability: Optional; the quality tool records it when present.

notes: The ordinary quality baseline document makes no PDF/A or PDF/UA claim; currentClaims describes that document only.
Selectable PDF/A-2/PDF/A-3 profiles are implemented by GeneratePdfA in the optional .NET 9 companion.
PDF/UA-1 is implemented by GeneratePdfUa, with mandatory final validation and author review.
The legacy DocumentMetadata.PdfA flag is not a validated profile.
